stem: Which detail from the selection explains why one attempt to fix the lean made the tower lean even more?

options.label: F
options.text: Cables and weights were installed to stabilize the tower s lean.

options.label: G
options.text: The tower continued to lean even after a bell chamber was placed on the tower s north side.

options.label: H
options.text: A concrete leak made the tower s foundation more unstable.

options.label: J
options.text: Soil was removed from beneath the north end of the tower to make the ground more even.
